note: Preregistered before any held-out policy evaluation (see git history: this file is committed before results exist).
split: leave-one-fold-out: priors, thresholds and policy hyperparameters are chosen on the other four folds only; reported numbers are the held-out fold; within a stream all learning is prequential (predict, then observe).
promotion_rule: PLANNER2_CAUSAL_PROMOTE iff the combined causal policy has lower mean operational cost than the best simple baseline (always-cdc, greedy, premium-cap-0.10, z3-expected-value) on >=4 of 5 held-out folds under BOTH price books, with mean relative improvement >=5% and no held-out fold more than 3% worse than always-cdc. SPECIALIZED iff it wins on >=2 folds but not the above. Otherwise NOT_JUSTIFIED.
oracle: exhaustive scheme-sequence search for chain histories (<=4^8 sequences); admission.Corpus oracle (B&B, 100000-state cap) for Z3-36 object frontier; both are migration-free storage lower bounds.
simulated_events: retention, reads and tick schedules are SIMULATED and labeled; arrival order and per-stage costs are real chronology/evidence.
